summary: Cohesive asset workspace feature: Preview/Edit composition, navigable provenance, thumbnails, media resolution, and browser action adapters.
context_hints: Use this feature from ProjectEditor instead of embedding asset business logic in the canvas shell.
Preview and Edit are states of one workspace; Canvas and Preview invoke the same shared Action Spec.
Keep Host-projected media URL validation and legacy/remote preview compatibility centralized here; GUI code never signs or rewrites storage keys.

Asset relations use project-wide ActionAssetBinding as the only Timeline/Canvas usage and input/output lineage authority; Canvas node assetId is only a placement/navigation projection, while prompt/model come only from ResolvedAsset provenance.

key_files.AssetThumbnail.tsx: Shared image/video thumbnail and type fallback component.
key_files.VideoPoster.tsx: Frontend video-poster state machine: optional legacy/remote thumbnail compatibility input, ready-only disposable first-frame decode, and object-URL cleanup.
key_files.AssetRelationsPanel.tsx: Docked Preview provenance rail and relation navigation controls.
key_files.relations.ts: Headless project-wide lineage and Canvas/Timeline relation projection.
key_files.media-url.ts: Canonical validator for current-Host media projections; rejects object-store keys instead of signing or rewriting them.
key_files.action-client.ts: Feature boundary for browser/server asset action executor clients.
key_files.useProjectAssetHydration.ts: Project/document-owned Asset projection watches. Preserve pending polls across canvas geometry updates; cancel removed targets and old Project callbacks.

architecture_notes: The feature collects user intent and calls executor adapters. Shared-types owns action identity and invocation semantics; APIs own immutable result persistence. ProjectEditor provides the complete project binding set plus raw navigation projections, but relation inference belongs in this feature and must never recursively guess media references from Canvas or Timeline payload fields. ProjectedMedia is the GUI element boundary and accepts only URLs projected by the current Host. Poster, waveform, and filmstrip presentation is frontend-derived and disposable. VideoPoster may read an already-supplied legacy/remote thumbnail compatibility projection, but Current Local does not request or persist a backend poster and never keys cache state by a projected URL.
